box-header.title: Billable value and cost by project · ${rangeText}

label.text: No project with time, invoices or a budget in this period.

Cost is the hours at the workers' rates plus expenses; billable value is the billable hours at the client rates plus billable expenses; margin is billable value (or what was billed) less cost; budget used is the actual client cost over the client budget. Billed counts the client invoices dated in the period.
